held.note: UNKNOWN outcomes produce no receipt and never enter the log.

cases.description: Refund, booking, dispatch and door unlock: attested, provider-confirmed, logged, with a consistency proof from the size-2 head.
The same valid bundle under default production settings: test keys are refused, so demo receipts never pass as real history.
A permission (attestation) presented as a completion receipt. Domain separation makes the signature fail.
Inclusion proofs swapped between two receipts.
A correctly signed door-unlock receipt that was never appended to the log cannot borrow the logged one's proof.
The dispatch attestation attached to the refund receipt.
The same refund receipt listed twice counts once.
Two different DONE receipts for one tenant and idempotency key: issuer misbehaviour, both rejected, never counted as two refunds.
A verifier that already saw the honest head is shown a different head of the same size: a fork, returned with both signed heads as evidence.
An older head whose first two receipts were reordered cannot be proven a prefix of the current head.
A smaller head delivered with a larger known head is rejected as rollback; same-clock signatures alone do not prove issuer truncation.
A head signed by a key the verifier does not trust.
Keys inside a bundle are ignored unless the caller opts in: without caller keys the bundle cannot verify.
Archival verification keeps history valid forever; fresh mode (conversation use) refuses receipts past exp.
A key retired before the later receipts and the head were signed cannot vouch for them.
